Container.Name: gupax
Container.Overview: Browser-based Monero mining — P2Pool + XMRig GUI with optional Tor
Container.Description:
Gupax-docker runs the Gupax GUI for P2Pool + XMRig Monero mining via a noVNC web interface.
Access the GUI at http://your-unraid-ip:6080 — just open in your browser, no X11 needed.
Set your Monero wallet address inside the Gupax GUI itself (P2Pool tab, "Monero Address" field). Mining cryptocurrency consumes significant electricity and may not be profitable.
Features: • Browser-based GUI via noVNC (port 6080) • P2Pool decentralized mining + XMRig • Optional Tor hidden service for private transaction relay • Persistent config, blockchain, and Tor keys across container restarts
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: monero xmr p2pool xmrig mining cryptocurrency noVNC

Config.Name: TOR_ENABLED
Config.Description: Start the Tor daemon (SOCKS5 127.0.0.1:9050). Nothing is routed through Tor until monerod is started with --tx-proxy=tor,127.0.0.1:9050.

Config.Name: TOR_EXPOSE_RPC
Config.Description: Publish wallet RPC (18081) on the Tor hidden service. Off by default: monerod RPC is unauthenticated unless you paste --restricted-rpc into Gupax.

Config.Name: VNC_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Password for VNC web interface access (leave empty for no authentication)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100)

Config.Name: SCREEN_RESOLUTION
Config.Description: Display resolution for Gupax GUI inside the container (default: 1920x1080x24)

Config.Name: MONERO_RPC_RESTRICTED
Config.Description: Adds --restricted-rpc to the recommended monerod arguments printed at startup (you still paste them into Gupax Node Arguments). Set to false only if you need full RPC access for external wallets.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: noVNC web interface - connect your browser here

Config.Name: VNC
Config.Description: Direct VNC access. Leave empty (default) to keep 5900 unpublished; noVNC on 6080 already shows the GUI. Only set this if VNC_AUTH_TOKEN is set — without a token x11vnc listens on loopback only, so publishing the port does not expose an unauthenticated desktop.

Config.Name: P2Pool Stratum
Config.Description: P2Pool Stratum - Connect external miners here

Config.Name: Monero RPC
Config.Description: Monero RPC. Only needed for an external wallet: monerod binds 127.0.0.1 by default, so this mapping is inert unless you also run it with --rpc-bind-ip 0.0.0.0 --confirm-external-bind --restricted-rpc

Config.Name: Gupax config
Config.Description: Gupax configuration, wallet, settings AND downloaded mining binaries (P2Pool, XMRig, monerod) — Gupax stores everything here

Config.Name: Monero blockchain
Config.Description: Monero blockchain data. In Gupax UI, go to Node tab and set database path to /home/miner/.bitmonero

Config.Name: Tor keys
Config.Description: Tor hidden service keys (keeps the same .onion address across container restarts)

Container.Changes: ### 2026.05.14 - Initial CA release. - Tor tx-only mode for private transaction relay. - noVNC web interface on port 6080. - VNC_AUTH_TOKEN for optional web authentication. - P2Pool + XMRig via Gupax v2.0.1 GUI. ### 2026.05.23 - Fixed template format for Unraid v2 schema (Config elements with Type attribute). ### 2026.09.27 - Capability hardening: template now applies the same cap_drop/cap_add set as docker-compose.yml. - Volume fix: Gupax stores config, wallet, settings and downloaded binaries in /home/miner/.local/share/gupax — the old "Gupax config" mapping to /home/miner/.local/state/gupax was never written to and has been merged into the single "Gupax config" (share) path. If you previously backed up the appdata/gupax/config directory, your real config is in appdata/gupax/share. - Wallet address is set in the P2Pool tab ("Monero Address"), not the Node tab. ### 2026.10.18 - Fixed XMRig not starting on the default UID/GID: the `gupax` group was never created when the runtime user already existed, so P2Pool could not elevate. - VNC port 5900 is no longer published by default. Without `VNC_AUTH_TOKEN` x11vnc binds to loopback, so noVNC on 6080 keeps working and 5900 exposes nothing. - Added `--init` (orphan reaping for Gupax-restarted children) and `--stop-timeout=30` to match docker-compose.yml. - `TOR_ENABLED` now states that it only starts the daemon; wallet RPC over the .onion is opt-in via `TOR_EXPOSE_RPC`. ### 2026.11.11 - Monero RPC (18081) is now documented as **optional**: monerod binds loopback by default, so publishing the port does nothing unless you deliberately rebind RPC and pass `--confirm-external-bind`. - Memory limit raised from 4GB to 6GB: XMRig's RandomX dataset plus monerod during sync did not fit in 4GB and produced OOM kills (exit 137).
